shared_elements: frontal standing figure (B) vs schematic figures (A)
justification: Both surfaces depict human figures with some indication of costume or headgear, but that is the extent of the correspondence: A shows small, thin, sketchy dark-line figures scattered across a broad wall in what reads as an informal multi-figure scene, while B shows a single massive frontal figure with lavish, densely detailed regalia carved in high relief on a vertical shaft with subsidiary panels below. The relationships and arrangements are quite unalike (a horizontal frieze of loose small figures versus one centred, symmetrical, hieratic figure), and the depiction conventions (schematic outline strokes versus dense naturalistic modelling with ornament) share nothing distinctive.
